requirements.requirement: Re-evaluate repository state and select one canonical pilot branch.
requirements.pass_criterion: Remote P0 branch exists at the exact authorized subject; P1 branch will be created directly from the closure commit.

requirements.requirement: Prove current pilot line contains working product head in ancestry.
requirements.pass_criterion: Product ancestor is the merge-base; no divergence.

requirements.requirement: Create pilot applicability overlay without changing production statuses.
requirements.pass_criterion: Overlay exists, binds protocol/registry and explicitly preserves production statuses; full 712 classification remains required before PILOT_READY.

requirements.requirement: Allow one active production writer lock.
requirements.pass_criterion: P0 lock was singular and is released at closure; P1 must acquire a new singular lock before changes.

requirements.requirement: Create pilot defect, failure, work-order and state registers.
requirements.pass_criterion: All opening artifacts exist in the exact nine-file subject delta; closure artifacts are append-only.
